Facade Insulation Workers – Vejle, Denmark

The job

We are looking for 3 experienced facade insulation workers for a construction project in Vejle, Denmark.

The work will mainly involve external facade insulation from scaffolding

You should have relevant experience from facade work, insulation, construction or carpentry. Experience with facade insulation systems is an advantage but not a demand

Your tasks may include:

• 
Installing external insulation on facades

• 
Cutting and fitting insulation boards

• 
Working from scaffolding

• 
Preparing facade surfaces

• 
Installing reinforcement mesh and profiles

• 
Applying base coat/render

• 
Finishing and preparing the facade for the final surface

• 
Following drawings and instructions on site

• 
Working safely and professionally as part of a team

We are looking for candidates who:

• 
Have practical experience in construction, facade work, insulation or carpentry

• 
Preferably have previous experience with external facade insulation

• 
Are able to work accurately and independently

• 
Can follow instructions and work according to Danish safety standards

• 
Can communicate in English well enough to understand work and safety instructions

• 
Are reliable and willing to work continuously throughout the project

Working conditions

• 
Start: 9 november 2026

• 
Working hours: 37 hours per week

• 
Normal working day starts at 07:00

• 
No rotation – you will work continuously in Denmark

• 
Project runs until 22 January 2027 with possible extension

 

Location

7100 Vejle, Denmark

If you are an experienced construction worker with a background in facade insulation, facade work, carpentry, masonry or similar, we would like to hear from you.

Apply now and tell us about your experience with facade insulation and construction work.

For further information contact Niels Søbye tel. +4527797214 mail; niso@moment.dk

jobs.description:
Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59pm, Monday 30 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position will most likely be held in the month of March 2027.

Are you motivated by building and operating robust, secure, and scalable IT infrastructure in a business where reliability and performance matter? Do you enjoy working hands-on with modern cloud platforms while ensuring stability, security, and efficiency across the organization?

We are looking for an IT Infrastructure Specialist to take ownership of our cloud-based IT environment. In this role, you will not only to operate and improve our infrastructure, but also to make technical decisions and drive direction within your domain.

You will play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations while continuously improving our infrastructure to support a growing and demanding business. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization as part of a small, focused IT team where ownership, execution, and continuous improvement are central.

This is a broad role with the opportunity to work across multiple areas of IT infrastructure. We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation, a curious mindset, and the drive to continuously develop both our environment and your own expertise.

Your responsibilities will include

• Operate our cloud-only IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, and security

• Administer and optimize our Microsoft 365 environment (including Entra ID and Intune)

• Manage endpoints, identities, and access controls across the organization

• Design, implement, and maintain networking solutions (e.g. cloud networking, firewalls, VPN)

• Monitor systems and respond to incidents, including security and operational events

• Implement and maintain security controls, policies, and procedures, ensuring alignment with standards (e.g. NIS2, NIST, GDPR)

• Automate and standardize infrastructure and operational processes

• Collaborate with teams across the business to ensure IT supports evolving needs

• Drive continuous improvement of infrastructure, tooling, and ways of working

• Provide day-to-day IT operations and end-user support, including walk-up support and troubleshooting

What we’re looking for

• Experience working with cloud-based infrastructure (Azure) in a hands-on role

• Ability and willingness to take ownership and make technical decisions independently

• Strong understanding of identity and access management (Entra ID or similar)

• Experience managing endpoints and device policies (e.g. Intune or similar tools)

• Solid knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, routing, firewalls, VPNs, segmentation) and experience implementing them in a cloud environment

• Practical experience with security operations (incident handling, hardening, monitoring, access control)

• Experience with Microsoft 365 administration

• Ability to automate tasks and workflows (e.g. PowerShell, scripting, or similar)

• Understanding of compliance and security frameworks (e.g. NIST, NIS2, ISO 27001, GDPR)

It would be an advantage if you also have

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code or configuration management

• Experience setting up and managing monitoring, alerts, and logging systems

• Experience working in a small team with broad responsibility

• Exposure to environments where uptime and reliability are business-critical

What we offer

• A young, ambitious, and fun working environment

• A steep learning curve and early responsibility

• Close collaboration with skilled developers, traders, and analysts

• The opportunity to work on business-critical systems with real impact

• Brand-new office in the heart of Aarhus, right by Dokk1

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Competitive salary package

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Apply now

Christian Harr

CBDO

cha@nitorenergy.com

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is transforming its existing client base to SimCorp One, our flagship enterprise platform for the world’s largest investment managers. SaaS is the foundation that makes this transformation scalable, resilient and commercially compelling.

As Sales Director, SaaS, you will sit at the centre of this growth mission. You will join a global specialist SWAT team working with regional Sales and Customer Success teams to move clients from on-premise deployments to SaaS-based SimCorp One. This is a client-facing, quota-carrying role with real ownership: from the first executive conversation and business case through solution shaping, commercial negotiation and signature.

You will help clients make one of their most important technology and operating-model decisions, while directly contributing to SimCorp’s global SaaS growth and the successful adoption of SimCorp One.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**Own complex SaaS transformation sales

• Lead the SaaS commercial motion for selected existing clients across EMEA, in close partnership with regional Sales and Customer Success teams.

• Own qualified opportunities from first client engagement through discovery, business case, proposal, negotiation and signature.

• Translate each client’s business, operating-model and technology priorities into a credible SaaS transformation roadmap and commercial proposition.

• Carry and deliver a multi-million-euro ARR target, maintaining clear opportunity strategy, forecast discipline and deal momentum.

Orchestrate the deal team

• Mobilise and lead virtual deal teams across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Platform, Services, Legal and Commercial Finance.

• Create clarity on roles, decisions, dependencies and next steps, ensuring complex sales processes progress with pace and quality.

• Engage confidently with C-level, technology, operations, procurement and risk stakeholders, adapting the value case to each audience.

• Lead commercial negotiations and internal governance, balancing client outcomes, speed and long-term value for SimCorp.

Accelerate the global SaaS growth engine

• Work as part of the specialist SimCorp One and SaaS SWAT team, sharing expertise and supporting priority transformations across markets.

• Partner with GTM, Marketing and regional leadership to identify the right clients, build pipeline and focus resources where conversion potential is strongest.

• Improve the SaaS pitch, value proposition and competitive positioning against alternatives such as remaining on-premise, running a client-owned cloud journey or full outsourcing.

• Capture field insight and feed it back into offer development, pricing, contracting, product roadmap, sales materials and enablement.

Build market confidence and repeatability

• Act as a visible SaaS thought leader internally and externally, making complex cloud and operating-model topics commercially relevant and easy to understand.

• Use standard sales plays, artefacts and governance while adapting the client journey to market maturity, installed landscape and transformation readiness.

• Create reusable deal patterns and lessons that improve conversion, consistency and scale across EMEA.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software, cloud, managed services, financial technology or a comparable complex solution-sales environment.

• Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals and meeting or exceeding multi-million-euro ARR targets.

• Strong commercial understanding of public cloud, SaaS, enterprise technology and recurring-revenue business models.

• Experience selling transformation rather than a standalone product, including the ability to build an executive business case and navigate long decision cycles.

• Good understanding of financial services and preferably the buy-side investment management industry.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional deal teams without formal authority and to create momentum in a global matrix organisation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional European languages are an advantage, preferably German

• Relevant higher education in business, economics, technology, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Capabilities and working style

• Commercial owner: You take accountability for the outcome, keep the client and internal team aligned, and move decisively from interest to commitment.

• Executive seller: You create trust with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and connect technology choices to measurable business value.

• Deal orchestrator: You bring the right experts together, simplify complexity and maintain clear governance across large virtual teams.

• Transformation mindset: You understand that a move to SaaS changes technology, operations, risk, economics and ways of working, and you can lead clients through that change.

• Builder and collaborator: You improve the sales motion while executing it, sharing insight freely and contributing to one global SaaS growth mission.

• Disciplined and curious: You combine rigorous forecasting and deal management with the curiosity to understand each client’s context and identify a path forward.

• AI-enabled: You use AI tools responsibly to research, prepare, synthesise and scale high-quality commercial work.

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more.

In addition to our traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and a hybrid workplace model.

We are committed to supporting continuous professional growth through training, knowledge sharing, leadership exposure, and opportunities to work with some of the most sophisticated organizations in the global investment management industry.

There is never just one route for development at SimCorp. We offer an individual approach to career development and encourage employees to pursue paths aligned with their ambitions and interests.

NEXT STEPS

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)

Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

The Role

As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.

• Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.

• Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.

• Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.

• Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.

• Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

Your Potential Background

We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.

You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

Required Skills

• Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.

• Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.

• Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.

• Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.

• Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Experience

• Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.

• Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.

• Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.

• Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.

• Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Danish is required.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

Product Security Engineer

**Enhance the Security of Future Endoscopy Solutions

**Are you passionate about cybersecurity and interested in protecting innovative medical technologies that help clinicians improve patient care?

We are looking for a Product Security Engineer to help build cybersecurity into the next generation of endoscopy systems and connected healthcare solutions.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing cybersecurity function and contribute directly to the security of products used by healthcare professionals worldwide.

In this role you will work closely with software, electronics, systems, quality, regulatory, and product development teams to ensure cybersecurity is integrated throughout the product lifecycle. You will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, improve security practices, and make a tangible impact on both product security and patient safety.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

**Key Responsibilities

**As a Product Security Engineer, you will drive cybersecurity activities throughout the development and maintenance of advanced endoscopic visualization platforms.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Drive cybersecurity risk management activities for medical devices throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead and facilitate threat modelling workshops, security assessments, and architecture reviews.

• Define, document, and maintain cybersecurity requirements for product development projects.

• Own vulnerability monitoring, assessment, prioritization, and remediation coordination across development teams.

• Manage Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation, analysis, maintenance, and governance activities.

• Investigate and drive resolution of cybersecurity issues identified during development, verification, and post-market surveillance.

• Contribute to and help ensure compliance with applicable medical device cybersecurity regulations, standards, and industry best practices.

• Collaborate closely with software, systems, electronics, quality, and regulatory teams to integrate security into product development activities.

• Drive continuous improvement of Product Security processes, templates, guidance, and tools.

• Act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for development projects and support teams in making risk-informed security decisions.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen product security posture and proactively initiate improvement activities.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we know the perfect profile cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you bring many of the following:

• An educational background within Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Strong interest in product cybersecurity and secure product development.

• Experience working in a regulated industry is a great advantage; but medical device experience is not required.

• Hands-on experience with design control, requirements management, risk management, and traceability.

• Knowledge of compliance with global cybersecurity regulations and standards.

• Good understanding of networking fundamentals, operating systems (Linux), secure software development practices, and fundamental cybersecurity concepts.

• Experience with system integration and complex hardware/software/software interactions.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to balance technical depth with product-level decision-making.

• The ability to work independently, structure complex work, and proactively drive progress across many stakeholders.

• Comfortable navigating complex technical challenges and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a global, cross-functional environment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and drive activities to completion.

**This is more than a product security role

**You will help secure technologies that clinicians rely on every day to visualize, diagnose, and treat patients. Working within the Product Security Team, you will contribute to the development of products where cybersecurity directly supports patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance. You will join a collaborative environment that values learning, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping establish cybersecurity as a key capability across the organization.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

GUBI is seeking a proactive, highly organized, and service-minded Showroom Manager to oversee daily operations of GUBI House Copenhagen, the brand’s showroom in Nordhavn, delivering an exceptional visitor experience and maintaining the highest standards of presentation. As the first point of contact, you will welcome architects, interior designers, trade partners, private customers, and VIP guests, representing GUBI with professionalism, warmth, and a strong sense of hospitality. The role combines oversight of the showroom’s daily operations with responsibility for its presentation and upkeep, while coordinating closely with HQ teams and the warehouse to uphold GUBI’s high standards throughout the showroom. As part of the EMEA Sales Team, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Warehouse, Customer Service, and Marketing to support smooth day-to-day operations, events, activations, and visits. The showroom also serves as an important meeting point for GUBI colleagues and partners from around the world.

Key responsibilities

• Take shared responsibility for the showroom activity plan, with a clear mandate to increase activity through new initiatives and unconventional thinking, helping establish the showroom as a high-activity commercial and brand hub that meets our ambitious targets.

• Manage the daily operations of the showroom, including reception, opening hours, visitor handling, and incoming calls, providing a welcoming and professional experience for all guests.

• Maintain exceptional showroom presentation and visual merchandising standards, with displays, furniture, and lighting reflecting GUBI’s brand identity and quality standards.

• Coordinate showroom updates in line with new collections, product launches, and seasonal activities, working closely with internal teams.

• Oversee the practical upkeep of the showroom, including cleaning, maintenance, and coordination with external suppliers and service providers.

• oordinate showroom logistics in collaboration with the Warehouse team, including incoming and outgoing deliveries, furniture movements, samples, and office deliveries.

• Maintain accurate records of showroom stock, samples, and inventory using relevant administrative systems.

• Establish and maintain a showroom visitor and activity log, providing an overview of visitors and showroom usage.

• Support the Sales and Marketing teams in planning and executing showroom events, activations, and client appointments.

• Coordinate the practical setup, on-site logistics, and breakdown of showroom events, including moving and repositioning furniture and display items, to prepare the space for each occasion.

Qualifications

• Previous experience in showroom management, premium retail, hospitality, or a similar customer-facing coordination role.

• Experience maintaining high presentation standards in a showroom, retail, or hospitality environment.

• Strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

• Experience coordinating activities and logistics across internal teams and external suppliers.

• Confidence in using administrative systems and digital tools to manage stock, records, and daily operations.

• Experience supporting events, client visits, or brand activations is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong understanding of professional hospitality and customer service.

• A background in furniture, interior design, or premium lifestyle brands is highly desirable.

• Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends to support showroom events and activations.

Language skills

• Professional fluency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

Personal attributes

• Structured and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.

• Proactive and hands-on, comfortable working independently.

• Service-minded and welcoming, with a natural ability to make guests feel valued and well looked after.

• Professional and confident in representing GUBI to clients, partners, and visitors.

• A strong communicator who collaborates easily across functions.

• Calm and organized in a dynamic environment with changing daily priorities.

• Resourceful and solution-oriented, with a practical approach to day-to-day challenges.

• A genuine interest in design, furniture, and premium retail environments.

GUBI is a modern design company offering a wide variety of luxury furniture, lighting, and interior objects for both residential and commercial settings. With a strong global presence, GUBI’s headquarters and showroom are located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About the position

Do you have a good eye for design, interiors and photography, and an interest in how a design house collaborates with creative voices? As GUBI’s Creative Partnerships & Social Intern, you’ll help build two new programmes from the start. One is a creative partnerships programme with photographers, stylists, writers and storytellers whose perspective brings something new to the conversation around design. The other is an affiliate programme with creators across Europe. You’ll work closely with the programme lead and collaborate with colleagues across Marketing and E-commerce, helping keep collaborations running smoothly from first contact to published content.

Key responsibilities

• Support outreach to new creators and partners and help onboard them into the affiliate programme, including preparing agreements and briefs.

• Coordinate gifting and product seeding, from approval through stock checks, shipping and follow-up.

• Support the content calendar and our social channels, and bring your own ideas to the table.

• Help create briefs for creative collaborations and attend shoots when they take place in Copenhagen.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform.

**What You Will Do

**

• Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs.

• Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base.

• Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product.

• Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns.

• Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product.

• Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side.

• Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems.

• A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users.

• Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs.

• Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features.

• A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

• Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus.
